runtime.entrypointPolicy: Package an entrypoint exporting exactly functions. Do not import the full index: it exports email triggers/workers. Existing historical builders are not a unified restart builder.
runtime.emailHelpers: Registration runtime imports emulator-safe email intent/token helpers; these are code dependencies, not worker activation. Cloud registration does not enqueue email intents or require the email vault.

email.existingCloudWorkers: Unknown until separately approved read-only inventory. Exclusion does not authorize deleting, retaining an unsafe worker or claiming that no deployed worker exists; any discovered worker requires compatibility review before release.

activation.legacyClaims: Preserve stored claims; never treat them as authorization. No owner bootstrap, identity changes or automatic membership backfill authorized.

storage.runtimeConfiguration: FIREBASE_CONFIG.storageBucket must match the approved actual application bucket.
storage.crossServiceRulesPermissionToVerify: Storage service agent needs roles/firebaserules.firestoreServiceAgent to read Firestore upload grants.

cloudPrerequisites.invokerPolicy: Verify existing service identities and invocation settings. Any exact-service invoker binding, API, bucket or IAM change requires a separate concrete approval; historical new-function counts do not establish current cloud state.

releaseRequirements: Clean approved final commit, Node 22 artifact preparation and checksums for backend/domain/web/Rules/indexes from one SHA; sourceBaseSha is provenance, not a final release attestation.

Approved current cloud inventory must account for every deployed data-access endpoint, including old claim-only endpoints absent from current source. No unsafe legacy handler may survive by omission; this local manifest cannot verify deployed code.

Backend membership and lifecycle guards first, then verify backend, deploy compatible Firestore indexes/Rules and Storage Rules, then web. Keep invitations disabled until separately approved online acceptance.
No full deploy, automatic function deletion, email activation, infrastructure repair, content backfill, owner handoff or production access is authorized by this file.
Do not roll back to claim-only or pre-disposition guards over current memberships/trash data; review compatibility and use a forward fix.
